description.zh: 文本生成 CAD（text-to-cad / cadgen）：在当前工作目录用固定版本的 cadgen 运行时执行 `cadgen …` 或 `python 模型脚本`，生成/检查 STEP、STL、3MF、GLB、DXF、工程图、URDF 等。先用 apply_skill 应用 cad / dxf / engineering-drawing / urdf 等 text-to-cad 技能，按其指引编写模型脚本再用本工具运行。经用户确认后执行；首次运行需联网下载运行时。
description.en: Text-to-CAD (text-to-cad / cadgen): run `cadgen …` or `python <model script>` in the pinned cadgen runtime inside the workspace to generate and check STEP, STL, 3MF, GLB, DXF, engineering drawings, URDF and more. Apply a text-to-cad skill first (cad, dxf, engineering-drawing, urdf, …) with apply_skill, write the model script as it instructs, then run it here. Runs after user confirmation; the first run needs network access to download the runtime.

program.description: cadgen：运行 cadgen 子命令（技能里的 `cadgen …`）；python：在 cadgen 环境里运行 Python 脚本（技能里的 `python <脚本> …`，如生成模型的 src/part.py）

args.description: program 之后的参数，如 ["src/bracket.py"] 或 ["doctor"]；路径相对工作目录

skill.description: 可选：所用 text-to-cad 技能名（如 dfm）。技能自带的 scripts/… 路径会自动定位，并安装其 requirements.txt

program.description: cadgen: run a cadgen subcommand (the skills' `cadgen …`); python: run a Python script inside the cadgen environment (the skills' `python <script> …`, e.g. a model's src/part.py)

args.description: arguments after the program, e.g. ["src/bracket.py"] or ["doctor"]; paths are workspace-relative

skill.description: optional: the text-to-cad skill in use (e.g. dfm); its own scripts/… paths are resolved and its requirements.txt installed
